name: Prologue
summary: A history lesson before the real reading starts. Marvels and History of the Marvel Universe walk through the big moments from the Golden Age on, and The Sentry introduces a hero with a secret the whole world seems to have forgotten.

name: Planet X
summary: Marvel Knights and Grant Morrison's New X-Men set the tone for the modern era. Bendis starts his long Daredevil run and Garth Ennis brings Frank Castle back to New York. Exiles and Runaways both debut along the way, and the X-books build toward a crossover called Planet X.

name: Disassembled
summary: Bendis takes over the Avengers, and the team's worst day is coming. Ed Brubaker starts his Captain America run and Joss Whedon launches Astonishing X-Men. Secret War and Extremis are in here too.

name: House of M
summary: The Scarlet Witch's powers are out of control, and the Avengers and X-Men meet to decide what to do about her. That leads straight into House of M. Spider-Man gets The Other, and the Hulk ends up somewhere very far from Earth.

name: Civil War
summary: A disaster in Stamford pushes Congress to pass the Superhuman Registration Act, and every hero has to pick a side. Annihilation kicks off Marvel's cosmic revival at the same time, and Immortal Iron Fist starts here.

name: World War Hulk
summary: The Hulk is coming home, and he's angry at the people who sent him away. The Initiative puts a hero team in every state while Annihilation: Conquest raises the stakes in space. The X-books build toward Messiah Complex, and Spider-Man gets a fresh start with Brand New Day.

name: Secret Invasion
summary: The Skrulls have been hiding among the heroes, and nobody knows who to trust anymore. Secret Invasion is where that paranoia boils over. War of Kings carries the cosmic side.

name: Dark Reign
summary: Norman Osborn comes out of Secret Invasion with real power and builds his own Avengers to match. Nick Fury goes underground with the Secret Warriors, and the X-Men look for a new home.

name: Siege
summary: Osborn sets his sights on Asgard, which is still floating over Oklahoma. Second Coming brings the X-Men's long Hope storyline to a head. The back half runs through Shadowland and Chaos War before Age of X closes it out.

name: Fear Itself
summary: The Serpent's hammers fall on Earth. Spider-Island gives everyone in New York spider powers, and Schism tests whether Cyclops and Wolverine can keep the X-Men together. Rick Remender's Uncanny X-Force runs through the whole thing.

name: Avengers vs. X-Men
summary: The Phoenix Force is headed for Earth, and Hope is its target. The Avengers and X-Men can't agree on what to do about it. Doc Ock makes a big play in Ends of the Earth, while Mark Waid's Daredevil and Jason Aaron's Wolverine and the X-Men are both in full swing.

name: Ultimate
summary: The whole Ultimate universe on Earth-1610, from Bendis' Ultimate Spider-Man and Mark Millar's Ultimates through Ultimatum and everything after it. If you're short on time, the essentials are Hickman's Ultimate Comics Ultimates plus Bendis' Ultimate Comics Spider-Man and Spider-Men.

name: Infinity
summary: Marvel NOW! relaunches the line after Avengers vs. X-Men. Hickman's Avengers and New Avengers build toward Infinity, and Bendis brings the original five X-Men into the present. Spider-Man starts acting very strange in Superior Spider-Man, and Matt Fraction's Hawkeye starts here.

name: Original Sin
summary: The aftermath of Infinity is creating new Inhumans all over the world, and Kamala Khan gets her start as Ms. Marvel. Battle of the Atom brings the X-Men's future selves to the present, and Goblin Nation is coming for New York. Original Sin closes it out with a murder on the moon.

name: Axis
summary: Wolverine has lost his healing factor, and the clock is ticking. New heroes pick up the mantles of Captain America and Thor. Spider-Verse pulls every Spider-Man together against the Inheritors, and Axis flips heroes and villains. Everything here points toward Secret Wars.

name: Secret Wars
summary: Hickman's incursion story reaches its end in Secret Wars as universes keep colliding and the heroes run out of options. After that comes the All-New, All-Different Marvel, with plenty of new faces in familiar costumes.

name: Civil War II
summary: A new Inhuman named Ulysses can see the future, and the heroes split over whether to act on what he sees. Avengers: Standoff and Apocalypse Wars come before the main event, and Captain America: Steve Rogers puts Steve back in the costume.

name: Inhumans vs. X-Men
summary: The Terrigen cloud is killing mutants, and the X-Men and Inhumans are headed for a fight over it. Spider-Man gets The Clone Conspiracy, and Doctor Strange deals with the Last Days of Magic.

name: Secret Empire
summary: Secret Empire puts the heroes on the run in their own country. Generations pairs legacy heroes with the originals, and Marvel Legacy brings back the classic numbering. Venomverse and Venom Inc. keep the symbiotes busy.

name: Infinity Wars
summary: The Infinity Stones are back in play, and everyone in the cosmos wants them. Hunt for Wolverine has the heroes chasing a mystery, and Damnation turns Las Vegas over to Mephisto.

name: War of the Realms
summary: Malekith has been working his way across the Ten Realms, and Midgard is next. Before that, Spider-Geddon brings the Inheritors back and Extermination sets its sights on the original five X-Men. Al Ewing's Immortal Hulk is running the whole time.

name: House of X
summary: Hickman takes over the X-Men with House of X and Powers of X and builds something new on the island of Krakoa. The rest of the line deals with Absolute Carnage and a 2099 event, while Immortal Hulk keeps getting stranger.

name: King in Black
summary: Empyre brings the Kree and Skrulls to Earth, and X of Swords sends the mutants to Otherworld. Then Knull, the god of the symbiotes, finally arrives in King in Black.

name: Devil's Reign
summary: Kingpin is mayor of New York, and he wants superheroes off his streets. Krakoa throws its first Hellfire Gala, and the Trial of Magneto puts a murder mystery at the center of the X-books. Inferno closes out Hickman's X-Men run.

name: Judgment Day
summary: The Eternals learn something about Krakoa they can't ignore, and A.X.E.: Judgment Day puts the whole planet on trial. X Lives and X Deaths of Wolverine land here, and Spider-Man gets Dark Web.

name: Fall of X
summary: Krakoa is riding high, and Orchis has been planning for exactly that. Sins of Sinister and Fall of X carry the mutant line to the end of the Krakoan era.
